lines.speaker: x
lines.text: Have you received the order?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Just came through.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: IV is the one who brought it in.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: All judges voted in favor

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: for the reasons stated in that document.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: If you require further elaboration, here's what IV said:

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: I have heard that the target has gone up to the surface for purposes other than attempting to reclaim it.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: IV also overheard that the target took forbidden objects from the surface

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: back to the Ark to sell them

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: on illegal websites.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: Some of the objects in question were also sent to the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: The Nikkes who accompanied the target up to the surface seem to have been kept in the dark.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: The Judges have therefore determined there is a high potential that this individual will engage in future terrorist attacks,

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: and have issued an Assassination Authorization.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: IV described the target as "a ticking time bomb."

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: His exact words.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: And no one knows when or where it'll go off.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: Precisely. A serious threat to public security.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: I believe IV is right.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: The target has exhibited a flagrant abuse

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: of the power they've been given.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: We must nip this in the bud.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: I believe that's all the explanation you should require.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: You can take it from here.
